Na EY, estamos comprometidos em moldar seu futuro com confiança.

Nós ajudaremos você a ter sucesso em um ambiente globalmente conectado, repleto de equipes diversas, e a levar sua carreira para onde você desejar.

Venha para EY e ajude-nos a construir um mundo de negócios melhor.

Você será protagonista na construção e implantação de programas robustos de Governança e Migração de Dados em clientes de grande porte, liderando grandes equipes, atuando junto aos clientes e impulsionando transformação digital com foco em excelência e valor de negócio.

Oportunidade disponível em modelo presencial (com flexibilidade) nos escritórios da EY em São Paulo e Rio de Janeiro.
Você assumirá as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Liderar e gerenciar projetos de migração de dados para implantação de ERP (principalmente SAP S/4HANA), incluindo:

  • Data Mapping entre sistemas legado e ERP

  • Data Quality & Data Cleansing
  • Execução de scripts de conversão e transformação (SAP Data Services, Alteryx)
  • Carga de dados (SAP Migration Cockpit)

  • Planejamento de cutover e go-live

  • Atuar no ciclo completo de gestão de projetos, garantindo qualidade, cronograma, escopo e resultados;

  • Liderança e desenvolvimento de equipe, promovendo feedbacks contínuos e gestão de carreira dos aconselhados;
  • Participar ativamente na prospecção e engajamento de novos clientes, contribuindo para estratégias Go-To-Market e metas comerciais;
  • Evoluir e fortalecer ofertas de Data Governance, propondo melhorias e boas práticas;

Requisitos e habilidades que buscamos:

  • Graduação completa
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes (aprox. 25%) e trabalho híbrido
  • Experiência comprovada em Governança e Migração de Dados
  • Experiência com SAP, SAP MDG, SAP S/4HANA

  • Conhecimentos em:

  • SAP Data Services

  • SQL Server
  • Modelagem de dados
  • DAMA DMBoK / CMMI DMM

  • Power BI, Datasphere, SAP BDC

  • Experiência em elaboração de propostas comerciais

  • Inglês avançado

Diferenciais

  • Certificação CDMP
  • Espanhol intermediário

O que oferecemos:
Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Wellhub, PLR, e muito mais.

Na EY, você se desenvolve com habilidades voltadas para o futuro e se abastece de experiências de classe mundial. Nós capacitaremos você em um ambiente flexível e potencializaremos seus talentos extraordinários em uma cultura diversa e inclusiva, com equipes globalmente conectadas.

Pelo 4o ano consecutivo, a EY está na lista do Great Place to Work como uma das melhores empresa para se trabalhar, com destaque para as categorias de diversidade. Você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

O time de Infraestrutura é responsável por organizar, manter e evoluir as diferentes plataformas que constituem a base da operação da empresa. Da organização dos serviços de computação na nuvem à segurança da informação. Estamos à procura de um Especialista DevOps apaixonado por tecnologia para integrar a nossa equipe de TI. Habilidades necessárias

  • Experiência em configuração de pipelines de CI/CD usando Gitlab;

description:
Profissional responsável por executar e acompanhar as atividades de Faturamento e Contas a Receber, assegurando a emissão correta de notas fiscais, o controle dos recebimentos, a identificação de inadimplências e o relacionamento com clientes internos e externos. Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, ou áreas correlatas;

title: Técnico em saúde bucal
description:
Quer fazer parte de uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas do Brasil?

Há mais de 39 anos no mercado, o Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes é uma das maiores redes de clínicas odontológicas.

Presente em mais de 20 estados, o nosso grupo é formado por 4 marcas que contam com a colaboração de 2100 colaboradores e um dos melhores corpos clínicos do Brasil.

Com conceito de clínica popular, somos determinados a garantir o pronto atendimento em ambientes seguros, confortáveis e climatizados por um valor justo e acessível.

Nós do grupo Clínicas Inteligentes somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Acreditamos que o atendimento humanizado contagia e motiva a todos que se relacionam conosco.

O Grupo Clínicas Inteligentes informa que sua participação em nossos processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhum fornecedor ou terceiro está autorizado a cobrar valores para candidatura à vaga, treinamento, material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.

Sobre a oportunidade:

Recepcionar pacientes no consultório dentário, procurando identificá-las e averiguar suas necessidades, para prestar informações ou encaminhá-las ao cirurgião dentista. Executar tarefas auxiliares ao trabalho do cirurgião dentista, visando a agilização dos serviços. Auxiliar o profissional, no atendimento aos pacientes, em tarefas tais como: segurar o sugador de saliva, fazer o afastamento lingual e alcançar materiais e instrumentos odontológicos. Fazer a manipulação de material provisório e definitivo usado para restauração dentária. Preparar o material anestésico, de sutura, polimento, bem como procede a troca de brocas.

Fazer a separação do material e instrumentos clínicos em bandejas para ser utilizado pelo profissional, zelar pela boa manutenção de equipamentos e peças, preparar, acondiciona e esteriliza materiais e equipamentos utilizados. Colaborar com limpeza e organização do local de trabalho consultórios, sala de esterilização e infecção. Realizar o controle dos materiais no estoque, solicitação dos materiais via sistema e cotação de compra dos materiais emergenciais para as clínicas, realizar as Cefalometrias e as fotos para realizar a documentação de Ortodontia dos pacientes, quando necessário. Realização de procedimentos básicos juntos aos pacientes (remoção de sutura, higiene oral, tomadas radiografias) sempre com supervisão do Dentista. Executar outras atividades correlatas ao cargo e/ou determinadas pelo superior.

Curso técnico TSB concluído + CRO ATIVO.

Horário: SEG. À SEX. 09:00 ÀS 18:00 | SÁB. 09:00 ÀS 13:00

The Partnership Officer will play a key role in expanding our business by cultivating and managing relationships with a diverse range of partners. This role requires a highly organized and motivated individual with excellent relationship management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Responsibilities

  • Create a systematic, process-driven approach for partner outreach and relationship management.
  • Develop an on-boarding plan and certification program to the partners to be completed following the enablement and orientation sessions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement joint marketing, sales, and support initiatives.
  • Collaborate with senior management, Business Development teams, and Strategy Manager to align our internal goals with new and existing partner relationships in LATAM.

  • Negotiate partnership agreements and contracts, ensuring terms are mutually beneficial and aligned with ProgressSoft´s objectives.
  • Develop a "Partner Kit" and collaborate with the marketing team to ensure partners receive the appropriate materials including branding guidelines, product summaries and presentations as applicable.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams, including Business Development, Marketing, strategy, Product Development, and Operations, to support partnership initiatives and drive results.
  • Identify and source partnership opportunities through inbound lead follow-up and outbound cold calls, emails, and client visits in LATAM.
  • Proactively seek out new partnership opportunities that align with the company's strategic goals, Business Development team's needs, and potentially complimentary products.
  • Analyze potential partnerships to assess strategic fit, value proposition, and potential ROI.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends, competitor activities, and identify emerging technologies and partners.
  • Forecast, measure, and report the results of various projects with partners, including co-created and/or co-branded content promotions, lead sharing, and/or event partnerships.
  • Analyze partnership performance, challenges, and opportunities to provide regular reports and insights to internal stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Possesses 3-5 years of experience in partnership management. 
  • Experienced in the IT and banking industry best practices, with a strong understanding of emerging technologies and their impact on financial services. 
  • Excellent knowledge of local LATAM payments infrastructure & industry.
  • Proven track record of successfully developing and managing partnerships.
  • Ability to track and analyze partnership performance. 
  • Ability to evolve in a complex environment.
  • Ability to operate with complete independence and autonomy.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent negotiation and strategic thinking skills. 
  • Proficiency in written and verbal communication in English is a must.

title: Freelance Accounting Consultant
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Who we're looking for:

We're looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double-checks assumptions and plays devil's advocate. 

Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

This is a flexible, project-based opportunity well-suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, experienced professionals and consultants with strong critical thinking skills.
  • People open to a part-time and non-permanent opportunity.

About the project:

You will create complex, realistic tasks that push frontier AI agents to their limits. Think scattered data, conditional procedures, and genuine domain expertise required. You'll build a detailed version with objective scoring, then write an ambiguous version intended to train the agent to succeed with less hand-holding. Real expert complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

If you have the relevant experience and are ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us

How to get started:

Apply to this post and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. To begin working in production, you'll need to complete the qualification step and project onboarding, where you'll get familiar with the guidelines interface and try your first real task with guidance from our quality team. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'd be directly shaping how useful these models become for your own future work.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Accounting, Auditing, Financial Accounting, or closely aligned areas.

title: Finance Analyst
description:
Objective of the role
The Finance Analyst will play a key role in supporting the analysis and structuring of financing transactions, assessing market rates, debt and equity alternatives, and applying advanced financial models. The position is expected to contribute to the design of financial strategies aligned with corporate goals, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and high-quality decision-making.

Main Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain financial models for corporate and project transactions, including the use of financing Model A.
  • Review and validate financial models prepared by external advisors, ensuring consistency with company assumptions and industry best practices.
  • Analyse and validate technical and financial assumptions together with specialised teams, assessing their impact on results.
  • Conduct market rate analysis and evaluate its effect on projects and financing structures.
  • Assess financing options (debt and equity), supporting the structuring and negotiation of alternatives.
  • Support capital raising processes (debt and equity), including the preparation of financial materials, participation in due diligence, and interaction with investors and financial institutions.
  • Prepare and contribute to capital presentations for investors, the board of directors, and other key stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with internal departments (technical, legal, commercial) and external advisors to ensure timely and accurate information flow.
  • Conduct market and risk analysis to support investment and financing decisions.
  • Prepare financial reports, presentations, and executive summaries for management, investors, and other relevant audiences.
Requirements
  • University degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial analysis, ideally in investment banking, M&A, and/or debt financing.
  • Advanced skills in financial modelling and analytical tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portugues (mandatory).
  • Spanish is a plus
  • Proactive, versatile, and curious profile with strong interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Commitment to sustainability and diversity values.
  • Flexibility and adaptability to take on new tasks according to business needs.

Internamente precisará trabalhar no alinhamento de conceitos, engajamento de recursos e profissionais, para, ao final apresentar uma proposta completa e aderente ao negócio do cliente.

Trabalhar com atitude proativa, comprometimento e engajamento são as principais características que buscamos nas pessoas.

Como arquiteto (a) de soluções, você tem a chance de se desenvolver em um espectro muito amplo, desde expertise em produtos, interação com clientes, comunicação, conhecimento em diversas áreas de negócios de nossos clientes e conhecimento geral do mercado de TI.

A pessoa desta vaga precisa ter paixão por oferecer soluções de impacto positivo aos clientes, através da construção de relacionamentos duradouros e de excelência. Tudo isso, dentro de um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, sem uma rotina fixa e com foco na construção de confiança entre todas as partes envolvidas.

Responsibilities

RESPONSABILIDADES


• Definir arquiteturas e propostas de soluções, utilizando técnicas de criação de valor ao negócio do cliente;


• Apresentar e articular recursos e benefícios da solução de tecnologia Oracle para a clientes em potencial;

title: Senior Completion and Intervention Engineer
description:
This position is for a Well Completion Engineer, responsible for designing and planning well completions, coordinating interventions, and supporting execution activities to ensure safe and efficient well operations from preparation to final closeout.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare and present well design concepts based on information provided by the Subsurface team.
  • Assist with the preparation of cost estimates used to generate yearly budgets and well/project specific AFE's.
  • Forecast and be accountable for the timely ordering of well/project specific long lead requirements.
  • Contribute towards logistical coordination and quality assurance of services, materials, equipment and personnel.
  • Integrate with fellow drilling, completion/testing, subsea and/or subsurface team members as required.
  • Perform special studies/duties if/as required, including conducting service quality meetings.
  • Ensure vendor service deficiencies are correctly and timely captured via the company non-conformance reporting (NCR) process to ensure timely action/close out.
  • Support NCR and root cause failure analysis as required.
  • Contribute to the development, management and updating of the Drilling Management System (DMS).
  • Ensure the DMS is followed during well planning, design, engineering, execution and closeout activities.
  • Ensure compliance with company and Drilling & Completion policies, standards and approved procedures.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied materials, equipment and services, including review of design, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Support the preparation of HSE documents if/where required.
  • Contribute and participate in the hazard identification process.
  • Contribute and participate in well/project specific risk assessments and pre-job planning meetings.
  • Assist with the evaluation of rig and third-party services for hazards, well integrity and assurance.
  • Support Drilling Management if requested in ER roles and incident investigations.

Well/Project Specific Duties:

  • Provide engineering support as part of the wells team, including optimizing well planning, design, engineering, costing and assisting with operation execution, as well as the services associated with these activities. Activities include performing offset reviews and well hazard identification.
  • Establish subsurface well/project life cycle functional and operational requirements, including material and equipment selection.
  • Identify special engineering studies to be performed.
  • Prepare well/project specific technical notes if/when required.
  • Prepare detailed scopes of work for tender documents, perform vendor capability assessments, evaluate tenders methodically and present a succinct recommendation.
  • Raise requisitions and purchase orders.
  • Ensure compliance of vendor supplied goods, materials, equipment and services, including review of design, manufacturing processes, quality plans, post-manufacturing testing/verification, site receipt acceptance, pre-assembly verification, pre-installation testing and equipment documentation.
  • Review all applicable operating, installing and testing procedures, including interface documents.
  • Assist with drilling-related engineering, mobilisation, installation and commissioning activities if/when required.
  • Contribute and participate in DWOP/CWOP/IWOP's as part of well/project commencement.
  • Ensure the Well Barrier Schematic is current and valid for the current operation being performed.
  • Assist with preparation of Management of Change (MOC) documents and conducting a risk assessment for those changes with relevant parties.
  • Review field tickets and/or well invoices.
  • Review the engineering-focused After Action Review (AAR) report and apply lessons learnt.
  • Responsible for compilation of End of Well Reports (EOWRs).
Requirements

Education:

  • Degree in Engineering 
  • Well Control certification (IWCF) - Subsea/Surface Supervisor is considered an advantage.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant Well Completion and Well Intervention engineering experience.
  • At least 5 years experience with operators in Brazil including IOCs.
  • Project experience on dry tree development(s) including exposure to conceptual and detailed design as well as execution of completions and well intervention operations.
  • Experience with lower completion and sand control designs and execution.
  •  Knowledge of appropriate and relevant well engineering tools (e.g. Landmark Suite (or similar) – Wellplan, WellCAT, Stresscheck, Compass, etc), and software packages.
  •  Knowledge of Brazilian well integrity regulations SGIP/SGSO.
  • Familiarity with well testing and well clean-up activities is desirable.
  • Experience with subsea completion and intervention considered an advantage

title: Freelance Economics Expert
description:
This opportunity is only for candidates currently residing in the specified country. Your location may affect eligibility and rates. Please submit your resume in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Who we're looking for:

We're looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double-checks assumptions and plays devil's advocate. 

Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

This is a flexible, project-based opportunity well-suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, experienced professionals and consultants with strong critical thinking skills.
  • People open to a part-time and non-permanent opportunity.

About the project:

You will create complex, realistic tasks that push frontier AI agents to their limits. Think scattered data, conditional procedures, and genuine domain expertise required. You'll build a detailed version with objective scoring, then write an ambiguous version intended to train the agent to succeed with less hand-holding. Real expert complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

If you have the relevant experience and are ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us

How to get started:

Apply to this post and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. To begin working in production, you'll need to complete the qualification step and project onboarding, where you'll get familiar with the guidelines interface and try your first real task with guidance from our quality team. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'd be directly shaping how useful these models become for your own future work.

Requirements

  • Postgraduate or four-year bachelor's degree (BS, MSc, MPhil, PhD) from reputable universities with a strong GPA
  • Professional industry experience in accounting with a minimum of 3 years in relevant economics fields (Economics Experts, Analysts, researchers, or consultants). An experience in cross-functional, applied, or international projects, will be an advantage, especially if your expertise has been used in real-world or consulting contexts.
  • Ability to write clearly and professionally, including explaining complex tasks in simple, structured language.
  • Ability to analyze and synthesize information from multiple sources and turn it into accurate, coherent outputs.
  • Creativity in designing realistic and engaging examples, cases, or workflows based on your domain knowledge.
  • Excellent analytical thinking: can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications.
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI-generated content.
  • Strong attention to detail: can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements.
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.).
  • Proven ability to use English fluently in professional settings, written and verbal (C1/C2 level).
  • Access to a laptop, stable internet connection, and sufficient availability to engage with project tasks.
  • Motivation to work with challenging, complex, but well-defined guidelines, learn new methods, and strengthen domain-specific skills.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $16/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

title: Assessora ou Assessor Tributário Sênior
description:
Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Impostos, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros. #TaxEY

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

#hibrido

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa assessora sênior de impostos, você será parte de Tax atuando em vários projetos globais e locais na área de Global Compliance and Reporting (GCR), ajudando grandes empresas a administrar e reduzir os riscos de suas operações, e assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades

  • Orientar a equipe na gestão de riscos e oportunidades que envolvam apuração de tributos diretos Imposto de Renda de Pessoas Jurídicas (IRPJ) e Contribuição Social sobre o Lucro Líquido (CSLL);
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);
  • Desenvolver as pessoas, por meio da delegação efetiva de tarefas e fornecimento de orientação à equipe, fornecendo feedback e treinamento com relação ao desempenho;
  • Direcionar o trabalho de campo, gerenciar o desempenho da equipe e manter a liderança atualizada sobre os trabalhos, documentando as áreas de maior risco;
  • Desenvolver constantemente a sua compreensão das tendências e processos atuais do mercado e compartilhar o seu conhecimento para desenvolver a equipe;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação do imposto diferido e respectivas projeções de acordo com as normas ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Atuar como especialista em várias equipes de atendimento ao cliente, participando de projetos na área de Business Tax Advisory;
  • Prestar consultoria na gestão de riscos e oportunidades que envolvam apuração de tributos diretos.

    •  Por que você?

    Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:  

  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – Lucro real e lucro resumindo) e na preparação/revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Graduação em Administração, Direito ou Contabilidade.

    • Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos: 

    • Vivência em projetos de suporte a auditoria, Compliance e Planejamento Tributário;
    • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.
    • Conhecimento nos principais benefícios fiscais brasileiros como Lei do Bem, Rota 2030, Lucro da exploração, entre outros;

      • O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Clique aqui e conheça nosso universo de benefícios.

      Quem somos

      Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão. 

      Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

      Segundo o Great Place to Work  2022, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

      Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor  

      Saiba mais sobre como é trabalhar na EY:

      Carreiras na EY LinkedIn @EY Instagram @eybrasilcarreiras

title: Inspetor Sr Ndt
description:
Descrição da empresa

A SGS é uma Multinacional Suiça, líder mundial em Inspeção, Verificação, Testes e Certificação, somos reconhecidos por nossa qualidade e integridade. Estamos presentes em mais de 140 países, com colaboradores no mundo, contamos com escritórios e laboratórios. Nosso time no Brasil possui  aproximadamente 4.000 colaboradores, distribuídos nas 5 unidades de negócios, sendo elas:

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Na SGS, fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços integrados de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos

e higiene.

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar

a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Em uma economia cada vez mais globalizada, sua organização deve manter-se atualizada com as complexas obrigações regulatórias, padrões e melhores práticas para reduzir os riscos jurídicos, financeiros e reputacionais. Com a expertise e o conhecimento de nossa equipe, trabalhando com processos e ferramentas avançadas, ajudamos organizações a melhorar resultados, gerenciar riscos, cumprir mudanças regulatórias e adotar melhores práticas, além de capacitar, tanto o profissional autônomo ou in-company, através do SGS Academy.

Valorizamos a inovação, excelência e colaboração em tudo o que fazemos. Respeitamos e apoiamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, vetando a discriminação contra qualquer candidato a emprego devido à  identidade ou expressão de gênero do indivíduo, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível, origem socioeconômica e/ou multicultural, condições de saúde, idade, religião, ou quaisquer características protegidas por lei. Temos orgulho de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais.

Se você tem como valores, integridade, espírito empreendedor e inovação, o seu lugar é aqui Venha fazer parte do nosso time

Descrição do emprego

  • Conhecimento e interpretação de desenhos, projetos, listas técnicas, diagramas de plantas químicas, petroquímicas e de óleo e gás;
  • Dimensionamento de recursos humanos, ferramentas, equipamentos e insumos para realização de serviços relacionados ao seu grupo;

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
Job Title: Quality Assurance Specialist 

Company: Vytelle 

Reporting to: IO Program Manager 

Direct Reports: None 

Location: Brazil 

Salary Range: Contractor 

Status: 1.0 FTE 

ABOUT VYTELLE 

We are a global precision livestock company reshaping how cattle producers worldwide unlock animal performance. Our portfolio includes world class Bovine phenotypic and genotypic data capture system via Vytelle SENSE and Vytelle INSIGHT which enables producers to accurately select desired traits to continually produce elite progeny, coupled with Vytelle ADVANCE In Vitro Fertilization Service, which enhances the speed at which genetic improvement can be made. 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

We are seeking a seasoned Quality Assurance Manager with a robust background in technology and software development. This role is designed for a dynamic professional who excels in leading quality assurance and control initiatives, ensuring the highest standards of quality in our cloud-based architecture solutions. With a pivotal role in our organization, the Quality Assurance Manager will be instrumental in driving our product excellence and customer satisfaction to new heights. 

ROLE OVERVIEW 

The Quality Assurance Specialist – SENSE Platform is a technically skilled professional with a software development background who is passionate about building quality into every layer of our product. This role is ideal for a developer who wants to broaden into quality engineering — combining hands-on coding, test automation, and problem-solving across SENSE's three major components: 

  1. Telemetry App: real-time, per-second data capture at customer sites. 
  2. Data Processing Pipeline: cloud services that transform raw telemetry into daily phenotype values. 
  3. Web UI Applications: dashboards, analytics, & animal trial management tools. 

You will play a pivotal role in designing, automating, and executing tests that ensure data integrity, performance, and reliability across this full ecosystem — from device to dashboard. 

FIRST 90 DAYS 

  • Learn SENSE's architecture, data flows, and operational objectives. 
  • Review QA documentation, test scripts, and known defect logs to understand baseline coverage. 
  • Build familiarity with the existing development and CI/CD environments (AWS, GitHub Actions, Playwright). 
  • Begin authoring automated tests for one end-to-end SENSE workflow (Telemetry → Cloud → UI). 
  • Partner with developers and the Product Assurance Manager to define acceptance criteria and test coverage for upcoming releases. 
  • Identify quick-win improvements for testing efficiency and reporting visibility. 

RESPONSIBILITIES 

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated and manual tests for SENSE's data-capture, processing, and visualization layers. 
  • Conduct white-box tests (code-level, API, and service integration) and black-box tests (UI, end-user workflow, regression). 
  • Collaborate with developers to integrate testing directly into CI/CD pipelines. 
  • Build and maintain test harnesses for RESTful APIs, data streams, and web services. 
  • Write and review test scripts in Python, JavaScript, or C# to validate logic and data transformations. 
  • Troubleshoot telemetry-to-cloud data discrepancies, working with developers to isolate root causes. 
  • Contribute to the design of performance and reliability tests for high-frequency sensor data. 
  • Participate in UAT and release readiness reviews, ensuring alignment with product requirements and field conditions. 
  • Document test results, create bug reports, and verify fixes. 
  • Continuously learn new QA tools, frameworks, and automation approaches.

SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE 

Education and Background: 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent technical field. 
  • 3–6 years of software development or test-automation experience. 
  • Strong interest in transitioning toward or expanding within Quality Assurance. 
  • Experience working with distributed or IoT-style systems is an asset. 

Technical Skills: 

  • Solid programming knowledge in Python, C#/.NET, or JavaScript/TypeScript. 
  • Experience with automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Selenium, PyTest, Postman/Newman) 
  •  Familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and message-based architectures. 
  • Understanding of relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) data stores. 
  • Exposure to AWS environments (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, ECS/EKS) is a plus. 
  • Comfortable working in Linux and Windows environments. 
  • Knowledge of Git, GitHub Actions, or similar CI/CD tools. 
  • Preferred: experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and telemetry data pipelines. 

Soft Skills: 

  • Analytical and curious mindset — enjoys tracing a defect through multiple code layers. 
  • Strong communication skills across remote, multi-disciplinary teams. 
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, iterative environment. 
  • Collaborative attitude and willingness to learn new domains (ag-tech, IoT, data science). 
  • Because this role supports global teams and requires regular communication with colleagues and customers in English-speaking regions, proficiency in English (verbal and written) is required. Candidates must be able to read, write, and speak English fluently to perform the essential functions of the position.

SUCCESS METRICS 

  • Increased automation coverage across all SENSE components. 
  • Faster regression cycles and fewer escaped defects in production. 
  • Reduced test execution time through CI/CD integration. 
  • Verified data accuracy between telemetry capture and phenotype calculation.

Description

Are you passionate about being at the forefront of emerging technologies in the maritime and offshore industries?  
 

ABS is a leading Classification Society driven by its mission to promote the security of life and property and preserve the natural environment. In fulfilling this mission, ABS leads research and develops guidance and requirements focused on the safety of implementing new technology in the marine and offshore environment. 
 

As a Marine/ Mechanical / Environmental Engineer, you will be actively engaged in driving industry-leading research and development associated with machinery and systems for marine and offshore applications. 
 

What You Will Do:

  • Lead research and assess the maturity of new technologies in the marine industry related to carbon capture, CO2 transportation, non-carbon/ low carbon-based fuels, renewable energies including different machinery and systems etc.). 
  • Establish guidance and classification requirements for the marine and offshore industry on the application of new technology. 
  • Support ABS technical community on queries regarding different onboard mechanical equipment and systems.
  • Maintain and demonstrate thought leadership through technical publications and presentations. 
  • Participate in industry societies to develop and enhance technical capabilities. 
  • Remains knowledgeable of new scientific methods and developments affecting the technical scope of assigned responsibilities and recommends changes in engineering processes and programs as warranted by such developments. 
  • Devises new approaches to problems encountered and recommends changes in methods, procedures, or design where necessary. 
  • Monitors the technical quality, content, consistency, continuity, and timeliness of action of all assigned projects. 
  • Maintains liaison with other engineering specialists, internally and externally. 
  • Assist Principal Engineer and/or immediate superior in developing qualification statements, proposals, bids, and other presentation materials. 
  • Promotes ABS Quality System within an assigned group of engineers.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

title: Environmental Education Consultant
description:
Result of Service

The Environmental Education Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Term of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

São Paulo, Brazil

Expected duration

Three (3) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. UN-Habitat is developing a project with the Municipality of São Paulo through the Secretariat of Green and Environment (Secretaria Municipal do Verde e Meio Ambiente - SVMA) that includes the revision of the Municipal Solid Waste Plan and the elaboration of the Municipal Sanitation Plan. To properly implement this project, an Environmental Education Consultant is required to work directly on the phases 3 (Study of Solutions) and 4 (Action and Goals Plan), to ensure adequate planning considering the current situation and future forecast for the city of São Paulo. These stages involve defining and proposing possible solutions to the problems and bottlenecks identified in the diagnostic phase, as well as developing the Action and Goals Plan, both consolidated in Product 3.8.1, the "Final Study of Solutions, Action and Goals Plan" of the Integrated Solid Waste Management Plan. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Environmental Education Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Environmental Education Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities. Based on the diagnosis prepared regarding solid waste management in the municipality of São Paulo, the consultant will develop the following topics, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze the municipal solid waste management diagnosis, identifying key issues, challenges, threats, and bottlenecks that hinder progress in management and the implementation of sustainable solutions; b) Identify and define priority axes for the development of educational, socio-environmental, and sustainability-oriented solutions; c) Prepare preliminary proposals for programs, projects, educational approaches, communication strategies, and pedagogical materials aligned with the defined priority axes; d) Establish technical criteria and reference parameters to guide the formulation of contracts, investment plans, service targets, and educational initiatives related to solid waste management; e) Contribute to the analysis of cost structures and financing models for educational actions linked to urban cleaning and solid waste management services, in coordination with the Public Finance Consultant; f) Assess and describe educational solutions, detailing their application across the territory and within the municipal governance structure, considering different target audiences (residents, schools, large generators, communities, cooperatives, etc.); g) Interact directly with the consultants from stages 3 and 4 to ensure the effective application of the solutions identified for the formulation of actions and goals aimed at improving environmental education in the management of urban solid waste; h) Develop additional activities related to environmental education and solid waste management that may be identified by the project coordinator. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Environmental Education Consultant shall assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Work Plan. Description: The Work Plan must contain (at a minimum): (i) Detailed scope of the deliverable products, focusing on the stages, methodologies, and related activities required to conduct the study on environmental education for solid waste management; (ii) Details of the information, documents, and data required to support the technical analysis and development of solutions; (iii) Schedule of activities and delivery dates for each phase of the consultancy; (iv) Description of the flow of review, technical validation, and approval of the products; (v) Identification of key municipal institutions, programs, and actors relevant to the environmental education agenda in solid waste management and the strategy for institutional articulation during the consultancy. Expected delivery date: 15 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – Integrated Study and Action Plan for Environmental Education in Solid Waste Management. Description: The Integrated Study and Action Plan for Environmental Education in Solid Waste Management must contain: Part 1: Study of Solution (i) Analysis of the complete diagnosis of municipal solid waste management, with emphasis on the environmental education component; (ii) Identification of key issues, structural bottlenecks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement within the current system; (iii) Critical review of institutional arrangements, existing programs, and communication practices related to waste management education; (iv) Identification and definition of priority axes for the development of sustainable and effective educational strategies within the solid waste sector; (v) Consideration of behavioral, social, environmental, territorial, and operational factors that influence educational outreach and citizen engagement; (vi) Assessment of national and international good practices, pedagogical models, and educational frameworks related to waste management and analysis of the relevance, adaptability, and applicability of these practices to the context of São Paulo; (vii) Preparation of preliminary proposals based on the defined priority axes; (viii) Development of programs, projects, pedagogical approaches, training models, thematic campaigns, communication materials, and tools tailored to different target audiences (e.g., residents, schools, cooperatives, large generators, communities); (ix) Determination of initial technical criteria, requirements, and institutional conditions necessary for the implementation of the proposed solutions; (x) Identification of intersectoral interfaces with municipal policies and institutions (e.g., PGIRS, PMEA 2024–2034, UMAPAZ Work Plan, SELIMP, SP Regula, SMSUB); (xi) Consolidation and detailing of the proposed solutions and definition of how they should be operationalized within the municipality of São Paulo; (xii) Specification of responsible institutions, required resources, key implementation steps, and enabling conditions. Part 2: Integrated Action and Goals Plan (i) Formulation of a structured Action and Goals Plan derived from the proposed solutions; (ii) Definition of objectives, expected outcomes, and clear implementation pathways for each action; (iii) Establishment of quantitative and qualitative goals, performance indicators, and monitoring mechanisms aligned with the strategic guidelines from PGIRS and complementary municipal policies; (iv) Estimation of preliminary costs and feasibility considerations for prioritized actions; (v) Identification of potential funding sources, partnership opportunities, and collaborative arrangements to support implementation; (vi) Ensuring coherence between the proposed actions, goals, and the PGIRS Action and Goals Phase; (vii) Integration of the educational strategies into São Paulo's broader municipal waste management planning framework. Expected delivery date: 60 days after signing the contract. The products must be delivered in accordance with the formatting and drafting guidelines adopted by UN-Habitat.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Pedagogy, Engineering, Biology or related fields is required.
• Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Waste Management, Environmental Education, Environmental Science or related fields is required, or additional three (3) years or relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Work experience:
• Minimum of six (6) years of experience in Environmental Education applied to waste management is required.
• Experience in Public Management is required.
• Professional experience developing studies, projects, plans and technical assessments related to environmental education and waste management is required.
• Experience in project management is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Excellent writing and proof-reading skills in Portuguese are required.
• Good computer skills in Windows, as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines is required. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of English and Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable. The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3/3 - BRL: 31.026,00 (Total net amount). UNOPS Salary Scale. The consultant will receive a total amount of BRL: 31.026,00 according to the following schedule:
• Payment 1 (40%): Upon delivery and approval of Product 1 (BRL: 12.410,40)
• Payment 2 (60%): Upon delivery and approval of Product 2 (BRL: 18.615,60) Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted in the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. Applications should be submitted through INSPIRA and must include all documents required at the system, please be ready to include the following information at the "Candidate Profile" (CP) at Inspira:

In addition to it, note experience not relevant to the position will not be considered. Estamos em busca de um Telhador experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe na ARO CONTABIL LTDA.
Como Telhador, você será responsável por instalar, reparar e manter telhados em uma variedade de edifícios comerciais e residenciais.
Este é um papel chave que exige habilidades técnicas sólidas, atenção aos detalhes e a capacidade de trabalhar em alturas.
Você será responsável por avaliar a estrutura do telhado, identificar áreas de reparo ou substituição e garantir que todos os trabalhos sejam concluídos de acordo com os padrões de segurança e qualidade.
A instalação de materiais como telhas, zinco e membranas impermeabilizantes será parte integrante do seu trabalho.
Além disso, você deverá colaborar com outros profissionais da construção para garantir que os projetos de telhado se integrem com outros aspectos da construção.
Experiência prévia como Telhador é essencial, juntamente com uma compreensão profunda das técnicas de telhado e dos códigos de construção.
Certificados em segurança de trabalho em altura e em técnicas de telhado são um mais.
A capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e a habilidade para gerenciar seu próprio tempo e projetos são também cruciais para o sucesso nesta posição.
Se você é um Telhador dedicado, com um histórico comprovado de trabalho de alta qualidade e está pronto para se juntar a uma equipe dinâmica, então queremos ouvir de você.
Junte-se à ARO CONTABIL LTDA e faça parte de um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza habilidades técnicas e comprometimento com a excelência.

title: Technician, Terminal Management Center 1
description:
Technician, Terminal Management Center


ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

SES is a Distribution Partner (DP) of Eutelsat OneWeb.  As a DP, the team member will be expected to assist in supporting SES customers utilizing Low Earth Orbit (LEO) terminals that operate on the OneWeb network and escalate issues to OneWeb as needed.  When required, this individual will need to schedule and facilitate troubleshooting calls between SES customers, OneWeb, and vendors.

The NOC Technician role is in a 24x7x365 office environment. This individual will be working in an operations environment responding to emails and answering phone calls to support OneWeb product offerings. The ideal candidate will be familiar with the demands and expectations of working in an operations center and is knowledgeable of radio frequency (RF) technology.

This team member will manage and maintain incoming customer requests and work closely with internal teams to ensure customer needs and external service levels are met. The role is focused on supporting the SES customer base. This role also requires a candidate with written and verbal fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS

  • Support customer calls and requests in Portugese, English and Spanish
  • Able to successfully learn and understand web based applications and tools for use in managing customer accounts. This will include navigation of OneWeb's portal (Device Hub) that is utilized extensively when troubleshooting performance issues with User Terminals (UTs).
  • Stay up to date on new technology, tools and applications that are used to provide the assistance needed for customer requests
  • Must exhibit sense of urgency to complete customer requests in a timely manner and engage internal support teams to take over troubleshooting in the event of a customer impacting issue
  • Ensure compliance with Intelsat standards practices and processes
  • Incorporate and leverage industry best practices while maintaining alignment with Intelsat goals and capabilities
  • Must be able to maintain customer privacy in compliance with all applicable laws
  • Manage positive relationships with customers to ensure customer retention
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Must be able to meet set expectations for call center metrics and customer turnaround times
  • Escalate customer reported technical service issues or requests to the appropriate NOC vertical team
  • Maintain accurate information and data in appropriate systems by tracking and capturing information and data

COMPETENCIES

  • Flexible and adaptive to change
  • Ability to operate in a team environment cross functionally where employees constantly provide support to each other
  • Customer communications – serves as the primary liaison for SES OneWeb customers, ensuring clear, professional, and proactive communications
  • Language skills – Provides multilingual support in Portuguese, English, and Spanish
  • Technical acumen – Demonstrates strong understanding of RF technology, satellite communications, network operations tools, and troubleshooting ability
  • Team collaboration – Works closely with multiple NOC technical verticals, vendors and customers to coordinate support efforts

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Written and verbal fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish
  • High School Diploma or GED required
  • 2 - 4 years of satellite communications experience including an understanding of RF technology
  • 1 - 2 years proven customer service including relevant experience or equivalent education experience
  • High aptitude for Networking and troubleshooting
  • Demonstrated ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Possess problem analysis and problem resolution skills
  • Ability to successfully navigate and use Microsoft Office Suite products
  • Must be available to work rotating shifts providing 24x7x365 coverage

OTHER KEY REQUIREMENTS / COMMENTS

  • Experience working with Network Operation Centers is a plus
  • Networking experience (CCNA, COMP TIA NET+, etc.) preferred

description:

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as an AI Tutor in Coding, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects. 

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you'll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Software Development, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or other related fields.
  • 3+ years of Kotlin development (Android or server-side).
  • Strong knowledge of JVM ecosystem and Java interoperability.
  • Experience with Android SDK, Jetpack Compose, modern architecture (MVVM, Clean Architecture).
  • Proficiency with coroutines, flows, async programming.
  • Familiarity with DI frameworks (Dagger/Hilt/Koin).

  • Ability to leverage AI-assisted development tools.
  • Experience building RESTful APIs, microservices, or distributed system interfaces.    
  • Experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data).
  • Experience with enterprise integration patterns and message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ).     
  • Database experience with both SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL solutions.    
  • Experience with enterprise security frameworks and OAuth2/JWT.  
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures and CQRS patterns.
  • Level of English is advanced (C1) or above.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

title: Finance & Control Lead
description:
A Clubbi é um marketplace B2B para pequenos mercados de bairro. Fornecemos uma nova forma de abastecer a loja: mais conveniente, aos melhores preços e com os melhores prazos de entrega.

Nossa visão é otimizar toda a cadeia de suprimentos e operações para este segmento do varejo, que representa um mercado de R$250Bi somente no Brasil.

A Clubbi foi fundada em 2020 e já chamou atenção de alguns dos melhores fundos de VC do Brasil e do Vale do Silício: Valor Capital, OneVC, Canary, Better Tomorrow Ventures.

Em 2022, recebemos a rodada Series A, liderada por ALLVP e Nfx.

Nossa Cultura e Valores

Nossa missão é fortalecer os pequenos varejistas como os maiores protagonistas do comércio na América Latina.

A gente acredita que por meio da digitalização de toda a cadeia de suprimentos e das operações do varejo podemos nos transformar no canal mais eficiente de distribuição para estes produtos.

Para ter sucesso neste objetivo, desenvolvemos uma cultura única e especial:

Nos desprendemos da nossa realidade para vestir a camisa pelo nosso cliente;

Desenvolvemos um time fora da curva;

Não temos medo de errar, desde que isso nos ensine alguma coisa;

Temos foco e somos obcecados por priorização e eficiência;

Tratamos adultos como adultos, com autonomia e responsabilidade;

Somos transparentes e não-hierárquicos;

Nos preocupamos genuinamente com as nossas pessoas;

Cuidamos para que a Clubbi seja um local incrível para trabalhar.

Acreditamos que um ambiente de excelência, aprendizado rápido, foco obsessivo no cliente junto com muita colaboração e diversão permite a todos alcançar o seu potencial pleno e contribuir com nossa missão.

Principais Atividades

Você será responsável por liderar a área de Finanças da Clubbi, garantindo processos financeiros sólidos, reportes confiáveis e suporte estratégico para todas as áreas do negócio.
 O desafio é estruturar controles e processos que sustentem nosso crescimento e tragam cada vez mais eficiência e precisão às nossas operações.

  • Ser o ponto focal da relação com nosso provedor contábil e garantir a precisão das demonstrações financeiras e fiscais.
  • Criar e aprimorar controles para o balanço patrimonial e DRE gerencial.

  • Gerir o fluxo de caixa, contas a pagar e a receber, assegurando conciliações e governança financeira.

O que Esperamos de Você

  • Curiosidade e flexibilidade para aprender e atuar em diferentes frentes
  • Espírito colaborativo, comunicação transparente e liderança positiva
  • Capacidade de usar dados e experimentação para embasar decisões

  • Abastecimento de insumos (papel toalha, sabonete líquido, etc.) nos locais necessários.
  • Apoio na coleta seletiva e descarte correto de resíduos, seguindo normas ambientais.
  • Zelo pelo patrimônio do cliente, atuando com discrição e cuidado.

Como se trata de uma vaga de Aprendizagem, não é necessária experiência profissional prévia. No entanto, valorizamos candidatos que demonstrem:

  • Experiência com organização (seja em casa, em projetos escolares ou voluntários).

title: Estagiário de Auditoria
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar auditorias de fechamento, fiscais e presenciais nas operações, conforme a escala estabelecida, garantindo a coleta de dados quantitativos e qualitativos;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de documentos, planilhas ou formulários diversos;
  • Auxiliar em atividades administrativas e demais rotinas do setor;
  • Participar dos treinamentos anuais e das reuniões de boas-vindas aos lojistas, em colaboração com o analista e o supervisor.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Vaga destinada para pessoas a partir de 16 anos;
  • Estar cursando ensino médio ou médio técnico;
  • Desejável conhecimento básico do Pacote Office;
  • Escala de trabalho 6x1 (Incluindo Sábados e Domingos)
  • Necessário Estudar à noite.

Existimos para conectar as pessoas com o que importa, servindo e encantando todos os dias e criando momentos que transformam.

Em um mundo em constante evolução, emergimos como uma poderosa força de transformação. Um legado com cerca de 50 anos de experiência que transformou o varejo no Brasil e consolidou uma trajetória de excelência e confiança, estabelecendo-nos como referência no mercado, com um portfólio de 59 shoppings presentes nas cinco regiões do Brasil.

Nossos shoppings são destinos vibrantes, repletos de oportunidades para empreendedores e marcas inovadoras. Com mais de lojas que atraem mais de 54 milhões de visitas por mês, criamos espaços acolhedores, seguros e inspiradores, onde cada visita se torna uma jornada de descoberta e conexão.

Criamos experiências físicas e digitais que transcendem as expectativas dos consumidores e geram impacto positivo na sociedade, com visão de longo prazo e resultados sustentáveis para lojistas e parceiros.

Clique aqui para mais informações sobre como seus dados pessoais na condição de Pessoa Candidata são tratados pela ALLOS.

DIVERSIDADE, EQUIDADE E INCLUSÃO

A ALLOS está comprometida com a criação e fomento de um ambiente de trabalho diverso, que acolha pessoas de raças, etnias, gêneros, origens, vivências e perfis variados, priorizando a inclusão social, a redução das desigualdades e práticas empregatícias justas, que promovam a igualdade de oportunidades.

Esperamos que todos os colaboradores, de qualquer cargo ou hierarquia, sintam-se acolhidos e se orientem pelo respeito mútuo.

As nossas vagas são destinadas para pessoas de diferentes grupos, incluindo mulheres, pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência ou demais grupos sub-representados.

Atenção: A ALLOS não realiza nenhum tipo de cobrança em qualquer etapa dos seus processos seletivos. Desconfie de ofertas de vagas que solicitem pagamento de cursos, taxas ou materiais.

title: Roaming IREG Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.
Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.
We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards.
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators.
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements.
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity.
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team. 
Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming).
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs.
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems.
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services).
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch.
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service.
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers.
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams.


Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills.
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.
